# CAN MESSAGE MAP

*Generated by `tools/rx7.py build` from `data/` and `templates/` — edit those, never this file.*

*Rev 2026-09-07 · owns: nothing — rendered from `data/can_messages.csv`, `data/can_fields.csv` and `data/modules.csv`. `firmware/icu/can_map.h` is the machine copy; the drift report in [`../03-INSTALL/BRING-UP.md`](../03-INSTALL/BRING-UP.md) says how far behind it is.*

**Bus:** CAN2 · 500 kbps · CAN 2.0B · 11-bit identifiers (D-086) — the PMU is CAN 2.0 only, so the shared bus cannot be FD. **Priority:** lower ID = higher priority, and priority is *per frame*: oil pressure lives in `0x200`, fuel level in `0x218`, so oil pressure always wins arbitration. At this bus load that is worth a quarter of a millisecond; what actually protects the car is that **no PMU control rule reads any of these frames** (electrical D-251). **The AEM wideband is the one vendor node** — a 29-bit, big-endian frame at 100 Hz, confirmed from AEM's 30-0300 sheet (electrical D-266); the receive filter and the PMU's CAN input both make that one exception.

## Contents

1. Nodes · 2. Messages · 3. Layouts · 4. Timeouts · 5. Bus load · 6. Design rules · 7. Before you code

## 1 · Nodes

| Node | Sends | Receives | Termination |
|---|---|---|---|
| Instrument cluster unit | 0x200, 0x210, 0x218, 0x220 | everything on the bus | — |
| Dash / climate control unit | 0x300, 0x310, 0x320 | ICU sensors, panel 0x400, PMU 0x100 for key state | — |
| Control panel (custom) | 0x400 | DCU 0x300 / 0x310 for key backlights | — |
| Wideband AFR gauge (the controller) | 0x180 ext | nothing | — |
| ECUMaster PMU-24 DL | 0x100, 0x110, 0x120, 0x130 | ICU 0x200 / 0x218 and the AFR frame as logged telemetry only (electrical D-251); panel 0x400 for defog / hatch / fuel door | **software, at the dash end** |
| LS ECU (engine swap, future) | 0x500+ | — | **physical 120 Ω at the engine-bay drop** (electrical D-079) |

## 3 · Layouts

All of ours are **8 bytes, little-endian**, standard 11-bit ID, **byte 7 a rolling counter** 0–255 so a receiver can tell a stalled sender from a quiet one — compare with `(uint8_t)(now - prev) != 0`, which wraps the way the counter does.

### 0x100 · PMU → all · Vehicle state · 20 Hz

*Layout fixed by ECUMaster — reconcile at V-065*

| Byte | Field | Encoding | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | Key position | 0 OFF · 1 ACC · 2 RUN · 3 START |  |
| 1 | Wake source | bitfield: b0 ACC · b1 RUN · b2 hazard · b3 door · b4 horn · b5 latch |  |
| 2 | Global fault | bitfield: b0 soft-fuse trip · b1 undervolt · b2 overvolt · b3 overtemp |  |
| 3 | Headlight state | 0 OFF · 1 PARK · 2 HEAD |  |
| 4 | Turn state | 0 off · 1 left · 2 right · 3 hazard |  |
| 5 | Pop-up state | 0 down · 1 raising · 2 up · 3 lowering · 4 fault |  |
| 6 | reserved |  |  |
| 7 | counter | rolling 0–255 |  |

### 0x110 · PMU → all · Power · 10 Hz

*V-065*

| Byte | Field | Encoding | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0–1 | Battery voltage | uint16, mV |  |
| 2–3 | Total current | uint16, 0.1 A |  |
| 4 | Alternator charging | 0 no · 1 yes |  |
| 5–6 | reserved |  |  |
| 7 | counter |  |  |

### 0x120 · PMU → all · Outputs · 5 Hz

*Bytes 0–1 were fuel level until D-306; reserved now*

| Byte | Field | Encoding | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0–1 | reserved |  | fuel level moved to the ICU's 0x218 (electrical D-249, D-306) |
| 2–4 | Output on/off | 24 bits, one per O1–O24 |  |
| 5 | Trip state — channel index | 0–23, cycling |  |
| 6 | Trip state — status | 0 ok · 1 tripped · 2 retrying |  |
| 7 | counter |  |  |

### 0x130 · PMU → all · Per-channel current · 5 Hz

*Multiplexed, all 24 channels in ~5 s*

| Byte | Field | Encoding | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | Channel index | 0–23 = O1–O24 |  |
| 1–2 | Measured current | uint16, 0.01 A |  |
| 3–4 | Soft-fuse setpoint | uint16, 0.01 A |  |
| 5 | Channel status | 0 off · 1 on · 2 tripped · 3 retrying |  |
| 6 | reserved |  |  |
| 7 | counter |  |  |

### 0x218 · ICU → all · Body / slow · 2 Hz

*Added D-306; oil pressure stays in 0x200 so it outranks fuel on the bus — priority is per frame*

| Byte | Field | Encoding | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0–1 | Fuel level | uint16, 0.1 % — three-point lookup calibrated in the car | the measured curve is in electrical D-249 |
| 2 | Fuel sensor valid | 0 fault · 1 valid |  |
| 3–6 | reserved |  |  |
| 7 | counter |  |  |

### 0x220 · ICU → all · Battery · 2 Hz

*Added electrical D-267: the ICU's radio co-processor republishes the BMS / shunt data; telemetry only (D-251) — SoC may be a secondary, fail-open term in the 11.5 V shed rule*

| Byte | Field | Encoding | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0–1 | Battery voltage | uint16, 0.01 V per bit | from the source, not the PMU's own reading |
| 2–3 | Battery current | int16, 0.1 A per bit, + = charging | a shunt sees every load; a BMS sees only its own terminals |
| 4 | State of charge | uint8, % | the source's own estimate |
| 5 | Battery temperature | int8, °C | 0x7F = unknown |
| 6 | Flags | bit 0 source (0 BMS · 1 shunt) · bit 1 heater on · bit 2 charge inhibited (cold) · bit 3 data valid · bit 4 radio link lost | valid = 0 → dashes (D-153) |
| 7 | counter |  |  |

| 4 | A/C request | 0 no · 1 yes — RESERVED, always 0 (D-211) |  |
| 5 | Outside-air temp | int8, °C | SN12, electrical D-256 |
| 6 | reserved |  |  |
| 7 | counter |  |  |

### 0x180 ext · WBO → all · AFR (AEMnet) · 100 Hz

*29-bit extended ID 0x00000180 (menu ID 1; ID 2–16 = 0x181–0x18F), DLC 8, big-endian, no internal termination — the two exceptions to D-086 / D-106; valid = byte 6 bit 7 set and byte 7 bit 6 clear*

| Byte | Field | Encoding | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0–1 | Lambda | uint16, 0.0001 λ per bit, big-endian — 0 to 6.5535 | AFR = λ × 14.65 (gasoline); confirmed D-266 |
| 2–3 | Oxygen | int16, 0.001 % per bit, big-endian — −32.768 to 32.767 % | confirmed D-266 |
| 4 | System voltage | uint8, 0.1 V per bit — 0 to 25.5 V | the gauge's own supply reading; confirmed D-266 |
| 5 | reserved (AEM) |  |  |
| 6–7 | Flags (AEM) | byte 6: bit 1 LSU4.9 detected · bit 5 free-air cal in use · bit 7 lambda data valid; byte 7: bit 6 sensor fault; other bits reserved | no rolling counter — AEM's frame, not ours; render dashes unless valid = 1 and fault = 0 (D-153); confirmed D-266 |


## 4 · Timeout behaviour — define it once, obey it everywhere

**A gauge frozen at its last value is worse than a gauge showing a fault.** Blank or dash it, never hold. The ICU renders a stale CAN value as dim green dashes, distinct from a hardware fault (D-153).

| Message | Timeout | Receiver does |
|---|---|---|
| `0x100` | 250 ms | assume key OFF, warn |
| `0x110` | 500 ms | blank the voltage field, never hold |
| `0x120` | 1000 ms | blank |
| `0x130` | 1000 ms | blank |
| `0x200` | 250 ms | ICU-local — this is its own message |
| `0x210` | none | — |
| `0x218` | 3000 ms | blank the fuel field; the PMU logs a received-channel fault |
| `0x220` | 3000 ms | blank the battery fields; the PMU logs a received-channel fault |
| `0x300` | 2000 ms | climate display shows —; the blower is unaffected, its final stage is on a local wire |
| `0x310` | 2000 ms | climate display shows — |
| `0x320` | none | — |
| `0x400` | none | — |
| `0x180 ext` | 500 ms | blank AFR on the cluster; the PMU logs a received-channel fault |

## 5 · Bus load

| ID | Bytes | Hz | bits/s |
|---|---|---|---|
| `0x100` | 8 | 20 | ~2,240 |
| `0x110` | 8 | 10 | ~1,120 |
| `0x120` | 8 | 5 | ~560 |
| `0x130` | 8 | 5 | ~560 |
| `0x200` | 8 | 20 | ~2,240 |
| `0x210` | 8 | 2 | ~224 |
| `0x218` | 8 | 2 | ~224 |
| `0x220` | 8 | 2 | ~224 |
| `0x300` | 8 | 5 | ~560 |
| `0x310` | 8 | 2 | ~224 |
| `0x320` | 8 | on change | — (event or unknown rate, not counted) |
| `0x400` | 8 | on change | — (event or unknown rate, not counted) |
| `0x180 ext` | 8 | 100 | ~13,200 |
| **Total** |  |  | **~21.4 kbit/s — 4.3 % of 500 kbit/s** |

Enormous headroom before the LS ECU joins. No reason to raise the bit rate or trim rates.

## 6 · Design rules

**Single source per signal** (D-078 → D-306). The PMU owns battery voltage, key state, output states and channel currents; the ICU owns rpm, water temp, oil temp, oil pressure, road speed and fuel level; the DCU owns climate and comfort state. The one deliberate double read is the oil-pressure node — the PMU excites it and reads it on A7, the ICU reads it and drives the old gauge from it (electrical D-258 / D-260) — a cross-check. **The ICU's critical gauges do not depend on this bus** (D-083): if CAN2 dies, only the PMU-published fields and AFR go blank. **Every frame of ours carries a counter; every timeout is explicit.** **Wire is control, CAN is telemetry** (electrical D-251).

## 7 · Before you code against the PMU messages

- [ ] `V-065` — export the PMU's real CAN stream definition from the client (electrical install §5.5) and reconcile `0x100`–`0x130`; update `can_map.h` and the data together
- [ ] `F-012` — bump `can_map.h` for `0x218`, the `0x120` reservation and the `0x300` byte changes; copy it over the three test-sketch folders; run `tests/run.bat`
- [x] electrical `Q-304` → D-266 — the AEMnet frame is confirmed; the PMU's CAN input for it is 29-bit, big-endian
